note: Returns are per trade, after slippage and charges, before tax. Excess is against buying every stock in the universe on the same morning with the same exits.

signals.label: Sharp dip in an uptrend
signals.basis: Above the 200-day average with a 2-day RSI under 10 (Connors and Alvarez, 2009).

signals.label: Three falling days in an uptrend
signals.basis: Above the 200-day average with three lower closes in a row.

signals.label: Among the weakest 5% this week
signals.basis: Short-term reversal: the worst 5-day returns in the universe tend to bounce (Lehmann, 1990; Jegadeesh, 1990).

signals.label: Among the strongest 5% this week
signals.basis: The opposite of the reversal rule: chase the best 5-day returns. Included as a check.

signals.label: 20-day high on heavy volume
signals.basis: Close above the highest close of the last 20 sessions on at least twice the usual turnover, in an uptrend.

signals.label: New 52-week high
signals.basis: Close above the highest close of the last year on at least 1.5 times the usual turnover (George and Hwang, 2004).

signals.label: Jump on results
signals.basis: Up 4% or more on twice the usual turnover as results come out: post-earnings drift (Bernard and Thomas, 1989).

signals.label: Drop on results (bounce)
signals.basis: Down 4% or more on twice the usual turnover as results come out. Tests whether the fall overshoots.

signals.label: Up day with heavy delivery
signals.basis: Up 2% or more with delivery share and turnover both at least 1.5 times their 20-day average. An India-specific idea without a published record.

signals.label: Gap up that holds
signals.basis: Opens 3% or more above the previous close and closes above its open, in an uptrend.

signals.label: Clean uptrend with momentum (the old screener)
signals.basis: Close above the 20-day, above the 50-day, above the 200-day average, with a 14-day RSI between 55 and 70. The shape of the removed screener's buy signal.

signals.label: Deep dip in an uptrend
signals.basis: Above the 200-day average, 2-day RSI under 5, and down 7% or more in five sessions.

signals.label: Dip in a strong stock
signals.basis: Up 40% or more over the last year (skipping the latest month), above the 200-day average, 2-day RSI under 10.

signals.label: Three falling days on low volume
signals.basis: Above the 200-day average, three lower closes in a row, each on less than the usual turnover: a fall without news.

signals.label: Big jump on results
signals.basis: Up 7% or more on three times the usual turnover as results come out, closing in the top quarter of the day's range.
